annie: heads up — q6b-int4 canary is showing strange promptset churn on the new quant kernel. Several golden anchors failed in the eval pass (precision drop ~6%).
vikram: wow, 6%? on which prompt cohort?
annie: longform-summary & code-extraction prompts mostly. sample ids: s-4421, s-4427, s-4490 (I pasted the top diffs).
selene: can you paste the eval snippet? wondering if tokenization shift or kv-cache trim.
annie: paste below:
```
Eval summary: model=q6b-int4-canary
cohort=longform-summary
metric=ROUGE-L
base=0.617
canary=0.582
delta=-0.035
```
vikram: hmmm. quant kernel changed the tokenizer config during build? that happened once with onnx export. marc, any infra changes on the canary hosts?
marc: infra side: only kernel patch rolled (memory compaction) — no tokenizer touch. opsbot: deploy 1736667800 q6b-int4-canary -> healthy (4/4) :white_check_mark:
annie: labelops-bot, did we recently re-run dedupe / canonicalization on the prompt bank? The failures smell like de-dup mismatch (different canonicalized text leads to different context prefixes).
labelops-bot: Recent dedupe run: 2024-11-18T09:12Z, algorithm=fuzzyhash-v2. Threshold=0.88. 12k candidates re-merged.
selene: if fuzzyhash-v2 changed, that could alter which anchor becomes "golden" for a cluster. Golden swap + quant kernel change => amplified delta.
vikram: agree. Proposal: pause canary, snapshot current golden set, pin dedupe version, then re-run the canary with identical golden mappings.
annie: +1. also want to run a short ablation: quant kernel w/ old prefix-canonicalization vs new. Quick script:
```
python eval_canary.py --model q6b-int4-canary --golden-snapshot gs-20241118.json --cohorts longform-summary,code-extract
```
marc: pausing canary now (taken out of rotation). opsbot: deploy 1736667900 q6b-int4-canary -> paused :rotating_light: 
annie: sending a note to label ops: selene, can you schedule a 2hr window for a controlled re-run and lock the golden set? We need labelers unaffected by new dedupe.
selene: booking 2hr slot 2024-11-19 02:00-04:00 UTC. I'll pin gs-20241118.json and set dedupe= fuzzyhash-v1 for the run.
vikram: we'll also run token-diff check to confirm tokenizer unchanged. small script I use:
```
python token_diff.py --a base-q6b --b q6b-int4-canary --ids s-4421,s-4427,s-4490
```
annie: thanks. if token_diff is clean and delta persists, it's likely quant numeric instability; then we test int8 fallback or higher-precision kernel.

vikram: I'll own the kernel ablation. marc, can infra keep the canary paused and reserved for tests?
marc: yes, reserved for the two-hour window. I'll re-enable only after confirmation.
selene: labelers notified, run queued. will post results here once done. :thumbsup:
